caption: The drawing depicts a ceramic pitcher with a wide body, narrow neck, flared lip, and a handle that is attached from the neck to the midsection of the vessel. The body of the pitcher is adorned with a decorative emblem or crest featuring several elements. In the center is a shield-like design with text that reads "Success to the United States of America" surrounded by ornate scrolling details. Above the shield is an American flag, depicted unfurled and waving. To the left of the shield stands a female figure in classical dress, holding a staff or pole, while to the right of the shield is a large eagle with outstretched wings. The pitcher is glazed in a light color, possibly white or cream, with a dark band around the rim, another mid-neck, and a thin band near the base. The emblem and figures are rendered in a dark color, creating a stark contrast with the pitcher’s lighter background. The handle is also light in color with dark outlining along its edges. The surface beneath the pitcher is plain and the background is neutral, emphasizing the pitcher as the focal point of the image.
title: Jug - "Peace and Prosperity"
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
